title: Rabbi Gamliel bar Avina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 3:10, asking a question before Rabbi Mana; in Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot, end of chapter 5, the reading is Rabbi Gamliel son of Rabbi Ilai.[^1]

notes.text: Guggenheimer Ketubot 3:10 fully names Rabbi Gamliel beRabbi Avina asking Rabbi Mana; the selected whole paragraph near the end of Shevuot chapter 5 reads Rabbi Gamliel beRabbi Ilai asking Rabbi Mana. Both readings and the question’s direction are retained without merging the patronymics or admitting an identity.
